hadithQuran.context: Screen title: daily hadith and Quran ayat

duaRequests.context: Screen title: dua requests (illness, death, other)

tag.important.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.general.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.event.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.facilities.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.timing.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.illness.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.inteqal.context: Small category tag on a card

tag.other.context: Small category tag on a card

todayHadith.context: Mint pill on the hero card

todayAyah.context: Mint pill on the hero card

quoted.context: Wraps a translation in the language’s quotation marks

english.context: Tag: the translation shown is English (no translation in the app language)

readFull.context: Button label: open the full reader

save.context: Bookmark button: keep on this phone

ameen.context: Button on a dua request (term from glossary)

forPrivate.context: Shown instead of the name when the family keeps it private

janaza.context: Row with the funeral prayer time and place

older.context: Collapsible section of requests older than 30 days

addToCalendar.context: Button: downloads a calendar file for the event

smaller.context: Accessible name of the A− button in the reader

larger.context: Accessible name of the A+ button in the reader

campaign.title.context: Screen title: a masjid’s donation campaigns (list)

campaign.status.active.context: Status pill on a campaign photo

campaign.status.completed.context: Status pill on a campaign photo

campaign.status.closed.context: Status pill on a campaign photo

campaign.raisedOf.context: Campaign card: amount received so far of the target, e.g. “₹72,000 raised of ₹1,00,000”

campaign.received.context: Caption under the received amount; the amount is what the masjid reported, not verified by us

campaign.lastUpdated.context: “when” is a date and time, e.g. “26 Sep, 8:30 PM”

campaign.daysLeft.context: Days until the campaign’s end date (0 = it ends today)

campaign.donateNow.context: Main button: opens the phone’s UPI app to pay the masjid

campaign.showQr.context: Button: opens a sheet with the masjid’s UPI QR code

campaign.disclaimer.context: Legal note under every campaign; {app} is the app’s name. Must stay exact in meaning (05 §8)

campaign.closedBanner.context: Shown instead of the donate buttons once a campaign has ended

campaign.qr.save.context: Button: saves the QR code picture to the phone’s photos

campaign.qr.checkName.context: Safety hint: UPI apps show the receiver’s name before paying; {payee} is the masjid’s UPI payee name

campaign.qr.changed.context: Notice in the QR sheet when the masjid’s UPI ID changed in the last 30 days; {date} like “2 Oct”
